verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a SaaS card-issuing platform that holds cardholder, card and transaction data. The evidence pack documents no export feature, no open-format downloads and no account-exit or portability process. API endpoints for creating cards and cardholders, and the MCP server and CLI, are developer building blocks rather than a documented data-export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
